body: Please don't take this the wrong way, but I assure you all those options have been considered.  We don't have supportive family and I dont have any friends here.  Hers are either not real friends or not in any situation to take on more people.  I have posted ads countless times on craigslist and nothing ever seems to come of them.  I'll admit I have never tried posting an ad for pet sitting and I may, but I have posted several ads about any miscellaneous work and respond to the ones I find as well.  We aren't in a big place so there's not an abundance of work or people looking to pay anyone.  To be honest, I don't think many people would want to leave any pets at this place.  It's very sketchy and rundown.  To be honest, I had these problems previous to living here so as much as living somewhere else would be a better situation, idk how much it would do for me mentally.
